hero.description1: Hi, my name is Kelvyn, i am a Software Developer with 1.5 years of hands-on experience. My journey began through self-study, dedicating over 8 hours per day of practice until landing my first professional opportunity. Since then, I was promoted from trainee to junior developer, working both on building a complete system from scratch and maintaining applications already in production.
hero.description2: I have solid experience with Next.js, NestJS, Docker, AWS, Azure, and payment integrations, along with knowledge in Linux, servers, firewalls, billing systems, and IT security. My daily workflow involves Agile practices such as Scrum, Kanban, and GitFlow, ensuring structured and scalable deliveries.
hero.description3: Learning new technologies and diving into documentation has become second nature, making me adaptable across different stacks. Motivated by challenges, I strive to keep growing while delivering impactful, scalable solutions for both users and businesses.

doclinix.title: Doclinix
doclinix.description: Digital healthcare platform with online scheduling, electronic health records, teleconsultations, and clinic management. Worked on building new features, payment integrations, and maintaining production, using Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Docker, and Azure.

grooveStore.title: Groove Store WIP
grooveStore.description: GrooveStore is an e-commerce platform for buying and discovering tracks, albums, and artists. Built with Node.js, Express, React, Redux and SQL, it includes authentication with Firebase, shopping cart functionality, and order management, using Stripe for Payment

ecommerceApi.title: E-Commerce API
ecommerceApi.description: This project is an e-commerce API that manages products, users, and orders. Built with Node.js, Express, and SQL, it includes authentication, shopping cart functionality, and order management, using JWT for security and Swagger for API documentation.

redditMini.title: Reddit Mini App
redditMini.description: This project is a subreddit browsing application that allows users to explore popular posts and access specific subreddits, built with React, Redux. It uses Reddit's public API to fetch real-time data.

jamming.title: React Jamming App
jamming.description: The application uses the Spotify API to search for tracks, add/remove songs, and save playlists to the user's account.
